title: Getting angry fries $50 million of computers at the Augsburg field station
summary: Lyn Buchanan tells of Getting angry fries $50 million of computers at the Augsburg field station, about 1980s, before he joined the remote viewing unit at Augsburg, Germany (and East German Soviet computers), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Augsburg, Germany (and East German Soviet computers)

tellings.quote: When I did, the entire field station went down.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, an Army sergeant who later joined a military unit that trained people in remote viewing, meaning the claimed ability to sense faraway places with the mind, tells a story from the 1980s at an Army field station in Augsburg, Germany. He says that when he got angry, the entire field station went down, and as he tells it about 50 million dollars of computers were ruined, with Soviet computers in East Germany also part of the story. If true, it would mean a person's mind can knock out machines.
